name: datarelay-atlas
description: Optional read-only DataRelay Atlas context for missing project continuity, prior decisions, lessons and provenance without blocking normal development.

interface.longDescription: Use DataRelay Atlas as optional read-only engineering context when canonical project facts leave a meaningful gap. Continue normal work when Atlas is unavailable.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use scoped DataRelay Atlas context only when missing prior decisions, lessons, or project continuity matter; reuse current context and keep working from canonical sources if retrieval fails.
